verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an agent framework with a managed platform (AMP) that exposes deployed crews over a REST API, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials to an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents creating scoped tokens, permission-limited API keys, or per-agent credential management. Assigning specific tools to tasks and reaching crews over REST are adjacent features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
